svg.title: Layered flat-vector person rig, right-facing side view
svg.desc: A simplified headless side-view person with one visible arm and two separate, equally thick rigged legs with right-facing shoes walking on a flat path.
svg.metadata: Candidate status: unapproved side-view visual direction. Structural authority: person-rig-candidate.svg front-view master. Construction: deterministic layered SVG with flat fills and explicit joint pivots.
